name: ingenium
description: Ingenium — a developer's Swiss Army knife for Claude Code. Layered workflow, web and game development skills that make AI-assisted development safe, optimal and fast. Bilingual (EN/TR) triggers.

plugins.name: ingenium
plugins.description: The full Ingenium toolkit in a single plugin. Workflow: safe-merge, refactor-safe, release-prep, debug-detective. Project: project-onboard, docs-sync, web-kickoff. Frontend craft: frontend-craft, perf-audit, motion-craft, design-system, human-made-design, pwa-offline. Game dev: game-design, pixel-game-dev, godot-dev, tauri-game-dev, multiplayer-netcode, shader-vfx, game-audio. All skills respond to both Turkish and English prompts.
